title: The Rattle Lair
description: The Rattle Lair — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Find Rattle Tooth's lair in Dew Valley Forest. When located, use a provided Waypoint Scroll to report back to the Sir Prize in Dew Valley.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Taking Down Rattle Tooth

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find Rattle Tooth's lair in Dew Valley Forest. When located, use a provided Waypoint Scroll to report back to the Sir Prize in Dew Valley.

Offer:

3 Random Non-member Potions

Turn-in:

So you found the entrance?! That's the best news I've heard all day. The next step will have to be elimination of this pesky rat.

Take these potions with you on your way.

Objectives:

  • Locate Entrance to Rattle Tooth's Lair

Client level range: 2–100
